tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bzhugs so// na mo gu ru uṣṇi bi dzā ya/ rnam par rgyal ma'i sgo nas 'di rang gi mchod rten kho na la rab gnas bya tshul ni slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin la bla ma gong ma gzhan gyi gsung gis kha bskang ste lag len nag 'gros su bkod na/ stong chog byed tshe de'i chas bshams la/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bsham ma dgos shing / ting shags dang rdor dril la khyad cher med pas spros pa la dga' na rdor dril bya/ mchod rten bzhugs pa'i drung du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rgyas par ci 'byor dang / phyogs skyong bsgo ba'i zlum gtor/ cha gsum gtor ma/ sbyang chas/ khrus sder/ me long / sku phyis rnams dang / rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog bum pa gcig rdo rje gzungs thag yungs dkar/ gu gul rnams bshams la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal stong chog las 'byung ba bzhin oṃ badzra a mṛ ta nas/ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag bskyed dang bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs ba nas/ yongs su gang ba'i nang du sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs kyi bar byas la chu gnyis sngon 'gro nyer mchod/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs shlau ka gcig gis bstod/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur zhes dang / legs so'i phyag rgya me tog dang bcas pas gzungs ring tshar gcig bton la bum pa la me tog gtor/ de nas gzungs ring tshar gnyis sngags thung gnyis brgya rtsa/ gong ltar mchod bstod pad kor dang bcas pas oṃ āḥhūm̐/

mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ de nas zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang drag po'i sbyang ba rnams spyi 'gre bzhin la/ bder gshegs pa'i thugs kyi rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod pa zhes sogs sbyar/ mchod rten gnyis yod na thugs rten dag la/ gsum phan chad la thugs rten rnams la zhes sbyar/ rten rnying pa la rten khrus dang rab gnas bya rgyu de la phar phyin drug gi khrus gang la ser sna ma bcas rgyun bzhin dang yang ji ltar bltams pa nas sku phyi ba'i sngags rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun bzhin no/ /mchod rten a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rten gyi 'og tu paṃ las padma/ a las zla ba/ bhrūṃ las 'khor lo/ bum pa'i nang du pad zla'i steng du bhrūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du zhu/ mchod rten la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mchod rten gyi rang bzhin rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ pad zla'i steng du skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten zhes pa nas/ lha dgu yongs rdzogs bskyed de/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi badzra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gnas gsum byin brlabs la dpral ba dang lte ba brla gnyis kyi yig 'bru rnams med kyang chog ma lus sems can nas/ rol mo 'bul ba'i bar don gnyis lhun 'grub bzhin dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbargya rtsa la sogs pa/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ byin brlabs/ 'jig rten khams kyi nas/ lda ldi 'bul ba'i bar stong chog bzhin/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung /

dpal mo gang zhig nas/ gtsug tor sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs spyan dbye don gnyis lhun 'grub bzhin/ sngags tsam gyis mchod pa 'bul tshul stong chog bzhin dang / sna tshogs padma sogs mchod rten gyi bstod pa 'bul tshul stong chog bzhin dang / sna tshogs padma sogs mchod rten gyi bstod pa shlau ka gcig rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ ye dhar brgya rtsa bzlas la 'thor nas 'bru re re bzhin ye dhar gyi yi ge ser po 'od 'bar bar gyur nas mchod rten la char 'babs pa bzhin thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la brtan bzhugs don gnyis lhun grub bzhin la/ thugs rten 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs zhes sogs grangs mang nyung gi rnam dbye sbyor tshul gong 'khod bzhin mchod pa gsar pa bsham pa'am min na kha gsos la bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs/ mchod yon phar cher sogs nas/ lda ldi 'bul ba'i bar stong chog bzhin dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas pas dpal mo gang zhig nas/ sprul pa'i sku la phyal 'tshal lo'i bar/ cha gsum spyi 'gre la gsang ba thams cad/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bya/ bden bdar gyi tshe sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i sogs sbyar/ chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying kha nas zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor chog bzhin la/ badzra muḥmi brjod par mchod rten gyi seng khri'i phyogs bzhir bzhugs par bsam la/ bdag gi rab tu gnas pa nas/ rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig gi bar don gnyis lhun grub bzhin/

rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kun rig gi mjug chog bzhin/ phyogs bcu na sogs rten bzhugs rnam rgyal stong chog bzhin/ bdag gi bcom ldan khyed sku nas/ dbul ba sel gyur cig gi bar dpal mo gang zhig ma'i mjug bzhin/ phun sum tshogs pa shlau ka gsum/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten sogs/ bdag gi tshe rabs sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sogs bkra shis ci rigs bya'o/ /de las cung zad rgyas par spro na/ dge 'dun bcu las mi nyung ba tshogs la gso sbyong nas 'khor 'das kyi mgron la gtor ma btang ba'i bar stong chog bzhin nyams su blangs nas rab gnas kyi sbyang ba nas chos skyong bsgo ba'i bar byas la/ cha gsum rab gnas kyi des go chod/ stong chog gi mjug gi mchod bstod bya/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba man chad rab gnas kyi mjug bzhin bgyis na gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal zhing cho ga tshad ldan 'byung bar sems so/ /zhes rnam par rgyal ma'i khyad par gyi rab gnas bya tshul 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos rang gi tshe spel ba sogs bstan don dgos gal che nges zhig la rnam rgyal gyi sku dang gzungs 'bum phrag bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bzhi gdan pa'i nye 'khor du 'phral bzhengs bgyis skabs slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal rtog 'grel dang / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i stong chog la gzhi byas 'phral mar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rab gnas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
